heading: When oral admission as to contents of electronic records are relevant.
text: Oral admissions as to the contents of electronic records are not relevant, unless the genuineness of the electronic record produced is in question.]
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Ins. by Act 21 of 2000, s. 92 and Second Schedule (w.e.f. 17-10-2000).
